name: Counter
hint: shows a counter's current value; {count:…} is the same read (Loyalty)
desc: Shows a counter's current value without changing it. To add to a counter, turn on "Bump a counter" on the command itself; this only reads whatever that option (or !counter) has produced. {counter:target:name} reads the mentioned viewer's own count instead of the channel's. Needs the Loyalty Points module.
targetHint: the mentioned viewer's own count, not the channel's
